name: 086.3 — a binding is an object
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 086.3: keybindings():binding() is a collection whose :list() ipairs actually walks, whose :get(id) addresses one Binding and mints for an id nothing has declared yet, and whose members carry the registry's three states — assign, "None" to unbind, and nil to put the binding back on the client's own default — with :default(), :assigned() and :info() reading them back, while the two spellings that addressed a binding by name are retired.
